name: Weather Vulnerable Site
description: One named physical asset (school, clinic, low-water bridge, river crossing) registered for site-specific severe-weather notices. Administered by standard desk CRUD, the watch-location house pattern. Saving a row auto-registers its 0.25 degree grid cell as a Weather Watch Location (warnings_engine/sites.py), so the hourly evaluator covers every registered asset; the hourly pass keeps the cell fresh so the stale sweep never drops it. Disabled rows generate no notices. All datetimes are UTC.

fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: The name used in end-user copy, e.g. "Tshakhuma Primary School" or "Mutale low-water bridge"

fields.label: Site Type
fields.options:
School
Clinic
Bridge
River Crossing
Other
fields.description: Drives the notice phrasing: bridges/river crossings get passability copy, everything else access/planning copy

fields.label: Route / Road Label
fields.description: Optional route or road, e.g. "R523" - shown in brackets after the site name in notices

fields.label: Tenant Site
fields.description: Optional owning tenant site name (the X-Rokct-Tenant identity tenant proxies send) - control-side registries carry no hard tenant link, per the role-split convention

fields.label: Contact
fields.description: Optional site contact (name/phone) - admin reference only, never sent to clients

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Admin reference only, never sent to clients

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Disabled sites are silent: no notices are generated or served for them

fields.label: Watch Location
fields.description: The grid cell covering this site - maintained automatically from latitude/longitude (warnings_engine/sites.py)
